folds.heading: ## Current selected stream seam, 2026-11-04 (B77)
folds.body: F2’s no-intervention statement is the October 14 source snapshot. Current seeded_streams exposes armStreamCall and peekStreamDecision; a loaded-dice call is retained on its owning stream, resolution stores its exact decision override, and ordinary receipt history remains bounded. The selected cheat action producer arms the loot call and the fate-ledger branch records a peek. This source reading does not implement or verify every Pin/Reroll/Bias/Steal/Blind option, caller, transaction or UI route. Pure unitDecision still differs from ensureStreams initialization and keyedUnit/log mutation; streamSeed can create a missing owner through ensureStreams. Keep the original F1–F19/R1–R8 locators and input fingerprints as history, refreshing only selected dependencies for actual behavior claims. Knowledge versus truth, real decision sequence, domain-specific cursors, evictable display receipts and secret-route boundaries remain material (AD32/AD36). No deferred cheat work or runtime proof is resumed.

folds.heading: ## Source-map scope retained, 2026-11-04 (B77)
folds.body: F1–F5 and C1–C5 record their named source snapshot; O1–O5/L1–L5 preserve distinct owners rather than a generic texture/clock/history engine. Current selected stream source has later loaded-dice call/override support, as [GX2 now records](../gx2/SOURCE_MAP.md#current-selected-stream-seam-2026-11-04-b77), without proving the entire lens/micro/offline palette. Causal use can freeze truth before revelation; current permitted fact views differ from occurrence-time utterances. Reuse actual durability, custody, world clocks, saved cursors and observations, with AD51’s shared seam direction and AD36’s proportional evidence. Retired viewport/model/dispatch details in neighboring old packets are history; current desktop direction and optional human feedback under AD42 govern actual selected delivery. No current-source absence census or runtime proof is implied by the map reread.
